t: Cate outdoor wall light, designed to elevate any exterior space. Pairs heritage-inspired style with a premium. hand-painted, rust-effect finish. Refined alternative to a standard lantern light and features toughened glass and is well suited to an LED filament bulb for an ambient glow (bulb not supplied). Built to withstand the elements whilst enhancing porches, patios, garden walls and entryways. Crafted from heavy duty aluminium and IP44-rated.
